meta_title: Green Giant Ground & Tree Care | Arborist Sheffield
meta_description: Green Giant Ground & Tree Care provides expert tree surgery, stump grinding, and arboricultural services across Sheffield and Derbyshire. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborists — Safe Tree Removal & Maintenance
hero_subhead: From overgrown branches threatening your home to complete tree removal, we handle every job safely and efficiently in Sheffield.
services_heading: Complete Tree and Ground Care Across Sheffield
services_subhead: Expert arboricultural work covering everything from routine pruning to emergency storm damage clearance.

services.title: Tree Removal
services.desc: Safe, insured removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We handle difficult sites and tight spaces, leaving your garden clear and ready to use.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Grind stumps below ground level so you can reclaim space and prevent regrowth. Perfect for replanting or landscaping plans.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Reduce size and density to let light into your garden and improve tree health. We work to British Standards and respect the tree's natural form.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Fallen or split trees blocking drives, threatening properties, or creating hazards? We respond quickly to make sites safe and clear debris.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge cuts keep boundaries tidy and healthy. We work to your preferred height and shape, removing all waste.

services.title: Site Clearance & Chipping
services.desc: Clear overgrown land, fell scrub, and chip branches into mulch. Ideal for developing gardens or preparing sites for landscaping.

about_pullquote: We do the job right — safely, cleanly, and with respect for the trees and your garden.
about_para_1: Green Giant was founded on a simple principle: provide expert tree care without the high-street price tag. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for honest, skilled work across Sheffield and South Yorkshire. Every team member is trained in safe felling and climbing, and we're fully insured for all aspects of arboriculture.
about_para_2: Customers trust us because we listen first, explain the work clearly, and leave sites cleaner than we found them. Whether you need routine maintenance or emergency storm clearance, we combine experience with modern equipment to get the job done safely and efficiently.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Our Work

reviews.text: Had a massive oak threatening the fence after the storms. The Green Giant team came out the same afternoon, felled it cleanly, and had everything chipped and cleared by end of day. Really impressed with how professional they were. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been meaning to get that old conifer removed for years. Called them on a Monday morning, got a quote same day, and they were back two days later to do the work. Fair price, no mess, and the garden looks massive now. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Susan P.

reviews.text: Emergency callout after we had a branch come down in the wind. They arrived within 90 minutes, made everything safe, and gave us peace of mind. Professional, friendly lads. Top marks.
reviews.author: David H.
